categories.main_business_segments: China Modern Dairy Holdings Limited operates primarily in two business segments: (1) raw milk business, which involves raising and breeding dairy cows to produce and sell raw milk; and (2) integrated dairy farming solutions business, which includes trading, production and sales of feeds and breeding products, as well as provision of platform services through a digital intelligence platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company pioneered the 'Zero-distance Integration of Forage Grass Planting, Cows Breeding and Milk Processing within Two Hours' production model, certified by SGS. It employs advanced technologies such as AI smart collars, 3D visual condition assessment, AI veterinary solutions, and digital platforms for 24/7 monitoring of the dairy value chain. The Group also developed the 'Modern No. 1' Genomic Germplasm Chip for breeding and operates a large-scale embryo laboratory for in vitro embryo production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group supplies high-quality raw milk to large dairy manufacturing enterprises in China, which process it into premium dairy products. It also serves small and medium-sized dairy farming operators through its integrated dairy farming solutions, including feed, forage grass, breeding, and digital platform services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates 47 dairy farms across 13 provinces and autonomous regions in Mainland China, with additional feed and forage grass production facilities in China and the United States. The majority of revenue and assets are concentrated in Mainland China, with minor operations in the USA.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Modern Dairy Holdings operates primarily upstream and midstream in the dairy supply chain, focusing on dairy farming (raw milk production), feed and forage grass production, breeding, and digital platform services that support the entire dairy farming value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group emphasizes digital intelligence and ecological practices, investing in AI-driven smart farming technologies, genetic breeding innovations, and sustainable development initiatives such as carbon emission reduction. It aims to strengthen core raw milk production, expand breeding and feed businesses, and develop a comprehensive dairy farming service value chain with one-stop solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of raw milk and integrated dairy farming solutions, including feeds, breeding products, and digital platform services. The Group also benefits from government subsidies and interest income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is a leading dairy farming operator and raw milk producer in China by herd size and production volume. It holds a strong market position supported by its integrated production model and technological innovations. It competes with other large dairy farming and milk production companies in China, including those affiliated with major dairy product manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group recorded revenue of RMB 13.25 billion, a slight decrease of 1.5% year-on-year, with raw milk sales revenue increasing by 1.9%. The herd size grew by 9% to approximately 491,000 dairy cows, and total milk production increased by 16.1% to over 3 million tons. Cash EBITDA rose by 19.6% to RMB 2.99 billion. Despite losses from fair value changes of dairy cows and goodwill impairment, the Group maintains a stable debt structure with a net gearing ratio of 97.1%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group differentiates itself through its pioneering integrated production model that ensures freshness and high nutritional value by minimizing time from milking to processing. It emphasizes product quality, evidenced by 11 consecutive years of Gold Prizes at Monde Selection. The use of advanced digital intelligence and AI technologies enhances herd health and productivity, while its commitment to sustainable and low-carbon practices positions it as a responsible industry leader.
